text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and NLP, and I’d be glad to support your new website with clear, persuasive German copy.

Your company operates in a specialized, high-trust space—personnel consulting for cybersecurity, risk management, data science, and ESG—so the website copy needs to do more than describe services. It should communicate expertise, credibility, and clarity right away, while staying accessible to the right candidates and clients. That is exactly the kind of writing challenge I would enjoy working on.

In a recent project, I built a contract clause search assistant for a legal client using Python, LangChain, the OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. It answered questions across 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. The assistant achieved a faithfulness score of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project reinforced how important precise language, structured information, and trustworthiness are—values that also matter in copywriting for a professional services website.

My background includes extensive experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. While my core technical background is in AI and data, I’m especially comfortable working with complex subject matter and turning it into content that is well-structured, readable, and audience-focused. For a German website, I would focus on writing copy that sounds professional, polished, and aligned with your positioning in the market.

If helpful, I can support you with homepage copy, service page copy, about text, and other core website sections, always with an eye toward clarity and search visibility.

Would you like the copy to be aimed more at attracting candidates, acquiring clients, or balancing both equally?
